article: Pythonで画像をダウンロードして一時保存・表示する
scope: Rewrote the Japanese article and twelve translations against current official Python urllib.request, tempfile, and webbrowser documentation. Checked HTTP timeout/status, MIME and PNG signature, bounded download size, safe temporary-file creation and cleanup, browser launch result, interactive wait behavior, environment limitations, source link, and duplicate publication dates.
findings: Removed the duplicated future date, preserved the original 2025-02-24 publication date, and added lastmod 2026-11-24 in every locale.
Replaced the third-party WebP URL and incorrect .png suffix with a PNG from Python.org; added Content-Type and PNG signature validation.
Added a 15-second timeout, a 2 MiB read limit, temporary-file cleanup in finally, and a user-controlled wait instead of deleting after an arbitrary three seconds.
Clarified that opening the downloaded file is intended for a local interactive desktop session and may not work from a remote notebook such as Colab.
Aligned all thirteen locales and added current official Python references.

post/Pythonコード片/index.ar.md.summary: Rewrote and aligned the translation to the Japanese source and current Python standard-library documentation.

meaning.note: Aligned the local desktop workflow, download validation, temporary file, browser-open behavior, interactive wait, and cleanup semantics.

terminology.note: Checked HTTPS URL, timeout, HTTP status, Content-Type, PNG signature, byte limit, temporary file, file URI, and desktop browser terminology.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical claims.

code.note: Compared identical code across all locales and exercised the valid-image and oversized-image branches with mocked HTTP/browser behavior; confirmed the wait path and finally cleanup. The actual Python.org PNG endpoint also returned HTTP 200, image/png, and the expected PNG signature.

links.note: Added current official Python documentation for urllib.request, tempfile, webbrowser, and the Python logo use page.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
The code was exercised with mocked HTTP/browser behavior; no browser was launched. The PNG endpoint was checked separately, but the code was not run against the network endpoint.
The sample is for an interactive local desktop Python session; browser launch and opening file URLs vary by operating system and are not suitable to assume in a hosted notebook.
